purpose: Recover final slide in separate real-derived repaired category, preserving source tape and physical world.
control: Same EEF controller with zero extension, unclipped IK targets in both modes.
repair: After last supported robot-can contact following physical release in baseline, insert up to 20 world-XY EEF increments of 0.5 mm toward the live goal. Hold recorded wrist orientation and grip. Stop after three supported can-goal contact frames or support/tilt violation; resume original absolute tool trajectory and withdrawal.
validation: Physical sequence scorer plus p99 IK thresholds 0.1 mm / 0.1 deg, then independent saved-action replay, then video review. No frozen bank replacement.
